<html lang="pt-BR"><head>
<meta charset="UTF-8">
<meta name="viewport" content="width=device-width, initial-scale=1">
<title>Prime Motors — Veículos Selecionados | Alta Floresta/MT</title>
<meta name="description" content="Prime Motors — veículos selecionados em Alta Floresta/MT. Seminovos revisados, financiamento facilitado e avaliação do seu usado na troca. WhatsApp (66) 9 9257-9322.">
<meta name="theme-color" content="#fe7201">
<meta property="og:title" content="Prime Motors — Veículos Selecionados">
<meta property="og:description" content="Seminovos revisados em Alta Floresta/MT. Financiamento facilitado e troca com avaliação justa.">
<link rel="icon" type="image/png" href="data:image/png;base64,">

<link rel="preconnect" href="https://fonts.googleapis.com">
<link href="https://fonts.googleapis.com/css2?family=Barlow+Condensed:wght@600;700;800&amp;family=Inter:wght@400;500;600;700&amp;display=swap" rel="stylesheet">
<style>
:root{
  --bg:#0d0f12; --bg2:#15181d; --card:#1b1f25; --line:#2a2f37;
  --txt:#f2f3f5; --mut:#9aa3ae; --gold:#fe7201; --gold2:#ff9a3d; --orange:#fe7201; --wa:#25d366;
}
*{box-sizing:border-box;margin:0;padding:0}
html{scroll-behavior:smooth}
body{font-family:Inter,system-ui,sans-serif;background:var(--bg);color:var(--txt);line-height:1.5}
a{color:inherit;text-decoration:none}
button{font:inherit;cursor:pointer;border:0}
.wrap{max-width:1200px;margin:0 auto;padding:0 20px}
h1,h2,h3,.cond{font-family:"Barlow Condensed",sans-serif;letter-spacing:.5px}

/* top bar + header */
.topbar{background:#000;color:var(--mut);font-size:13px}
.topbar .wrap{display:flex;justify-content:space-between;gap:12px;padding-top:7px;padding-bottom:7px;flex-wrap:wrap}
.hbanner{background:linear-gradient(90deg,#1d1d1d 50%,#fc7001 50%);display:flex;justify-content:center;overflow:hidden}
.hbanner img{display:block;width:100%;max-width:640px;height:auto}
header{position:sticky;top:0;z-index:50;background:#111214;border-bottom:3px solid var(--orange);box-shadow:0 4px 20px #0006}
header .wrap{display:flex;align-items:center;justify-content:center;height:46px;gap:20px}
.menu-lbl{display:none}
.logo img{height:68px;display:block}
.logo{display:flex;align-items:center;gap:10px}
.logo b{font-family:"Barlow Condensed";font-size:28px;font-weight:800;letter-spacing:1px}
.logo b span{color:var(--gold)}
nav{display:flex;gap:4px}
nav a{padding:6px 13px;border-radius:7px;font-weight:700;font-size:14px;color:#fff}
nav a:hover{color:var(--gold2)}
nav a.on{color:#fff;background:var(--orange)}
nav a.nav-loja{border:1px solid #fe720166;color:var(--gold2);margin-left:8px}
nav a.nav-loja:hover{background:#fe720122}
.btn{display:inline-flex;align-items:center;gap:8px;padding:12px 22px;border-radius:10px;font-weight:700;font-size:15px;transition:.15s}
.btn-gold{background:var(--orange);color:#fff}
.btn-gold:hover{filter:brightness(1.08);transform:translateY(-1px)}
.btn-line{border:1.5px solid var(--gold);color:var(--gold2);background:transparent}
.btn-line:hover{background:#fe720118}
.btn-wa{background:var(--wa);color:#06280f}
.menu-btn{display:none;background:none;color:#fff;font-size:28px}
@media(max-width:860px){
  nav{display:none;position:absolute;top:49px;left:0;right:0;background:#111;flex-direction:column;padding:12px;border-bottom:1px solid var(--line)}
  nav.open{display:flex}
  .menu-btn{display:block}
  header .wrap{justify-content:space-between}
  .menu-lbl{display:block;color:#fff;font-weight:700;font-family:"Barlow Condensed";font-size:20px;letter-spacing:1px;text-transform:uppercase}
  header .btn-wa{display:none}
}

/* views */
.view{display:none}
.view.on{display:block}

/* hero */
.hero{position:relative;overflow:hidden;background:radial-gradient(ellipse at 75% 40%,#3a1a02 0%,var(--bg) 60%)}
.hero .wrap{display:grid;grid-template-columns:1fr 1fr;align-items:center;gap:30px;padding-top:50px;padding-bottom:70px}
.hero .tag{display:inline-block;color:var(--gold2);border:1px solid #fe720155;padding:3px 9px;border-radius:30px;font-size:10px;font-weight:600;margin-bottom:11px}
.hero h1{font-size:clamp(21px,2.56vw,35px);line-height:.95;font-weight:800;text-transform:uppercase}
.hero h1 em{font-style:normal;color:var(--gold)}
.hero p{color:var(--mut);font-size:13px;margin:13px 0 19px;max-width:370px}
.hero .ctas{display:flex;gap:8px;flex-wrap:wrap}
.hero .ctas .btn{padding:9px 14px;font-size:12px;border-radius:8px}
.hero-car{width:100%;filter:drop-shadow(0 30px 40px #000)}
.hshow{position:relative;width:80%;margin-left:auto;aspect-ratio:16/10;border-radius:20px;overflow:hidden;background:#090a0c;border:1px solid #fe720155;box-shadow:0 30px 60px #000a;cursor:pointer}
.hslide{position:absolute;inset:0;opacity:0;pointer-events:none;transition:opacity .9s ease,transform 6s ease;transform:scale(1.04)}
.hslide.on{opacity:1;transform:scale(1);pointer-events:auto}
.hslide .bgb{position:absolute;inset:-20px;background-size:cover;background-position:center;filter:blur(22px) brightness(.4)}
.hslide img{position:absolute;inset:0;width:100%;height:100%;object-fit:contain}
.hslide svg{position:absolute;inset:0;margin:auto;width:82%;height:82%}
.hcap{position:absolute;left:0;right:0;bottom:0;padding:40px 22px 18px;background:linear-gradient(transparent,#000d);display:flex;justify-content:space-between;align-items:flex-end;gap:12px}
.hcap .mk{color:var(--gold2);font-size:12px;font-weight:700;text-transform:uppercase;letter-spacing:1px}
.hcap h3{font-size:24px;line-height:1;color:#fff}
.hcap .y{color:#c9cfd6;font-size:13px;margin-top:4px}
.hcap .p{font-family:"Barlow Condensed";font-size:24px;font-weight:800;color:#fff;background:var(--orange);padding:4px 12px;border-radius:10px;white-space:nowrap}
.hdots{position:absolute;top:14px;right:14px;display:flex;gap:5px;z-index:2}
.hdots i{width:8px;height:8px;border-radius:50%;background:#ffffff55;cursor:pointer}
.hdots i.on{background:var(--orange);width:22px;border-radius:4px}
.hnav{position:absolute;top:50%;transform:translateY(-50%);z-index:2;width:40px;height:40px;border-radius:50%;background:#000a;color:#fff;font-size:24px;opacity:0;transition:.2s}
.hshow:hover .hnav{opacity:1}.hnav:hover{background:var(--orange)}
.hnav.l{left:10px}.hnav.r{right:10px}
@media(max-width:860px){.hshow{margin:0 auto;aspect-ratio:4/3;width:100%}.hcap h3{font-size:24px}.hcap .p{font-size:24px}.hnav{opacity:1;width:34px;height:34px;font-size:20px}}
@media(max-width:860px){.hero .wrap{grid-template-columns:1fr;padding-top:40px}}

/* search box */
.search{background:var(--card);border:1px solid var(--line);border-radius:16px;padding:22px;margin-top:-36px;position:relative;z-index:2;display:grid;grid-template-columns:repeat(4,1fr) auto;gap:12px;box-shadow:0 20px 40px #0008}
.search label{font-size:12px;color:var(--mut);font-weight:600;display:block;margin-bottom:5px;text-transform:uppercase;letter-spacing:.5px}
select,input,textarea{width:100%;background:var(--bg2);border:1px solid var(--line);color:var(--txt);padding:11px 12px;border-radius:9px;font:inherit;font-size:15px}
select:focus,input:focus,textarea:focus{outline:2px solid var(--gold);border-color:transparent}
.search .btn{align-self:end;height:46px}
@media(max-width:860px){.search{grid-template-columns:1fr 1fr}.search .btn{grid-column:1/-1;justify-content:center}}

section{padding:70px 0}
.sec-head{display:flex;justify-content:space-between;align-items:end;margin-bottom:28px;gap:16px;flex-wrap:wrap}
.sec-head h2{font-size:40px;text-transform:uppercase;font-weight:800}
.sec-head h2 span{color:var(--gold)}
.sec-head p{color:var(--mut)}
.link-more{color:var(--gold2);font-weight:600}

/* brands */
.brands{display:grid;grid-template-columns:repeat(8,1fr);gap:10px}
.brand{background:var(--card);border:1px solid var(--line);border-radius:12px;padding:16px 8px;text-align:center;font-family:"Barlow Condensed";font-weight:700;font-size:17px;text-transform:uppercase;color:#cfd4da;transition:.15s}
.brand:hover{border-color:var(--gold);color:var(--gold2);transform:translateY(-2px)}
.brand small{display:block;font-family:Inter;font-size:11px;color:var(--mut);font-weight:500;text-transform:none}
@media(max-width:860px){.brands{grid-template-columns:repeat(4,1fr)}}

/* cards */
.grid{display:grid;grid-template-columns:repeat(auto-fill,minmax(270px,1fr));gap:20px}
.car{background:var(--card);border:1px solid var(--line);border-radius:16px;overflow:hidden;transition:.18s;display:flex;flex-direction:column}
.car:hover{border-color:#fe720188;transform:translateY(-3px);box-shadow:0 14px 30px #0007}
.car .img{aspect-ratio:16/10;display:flex;align-items:center;justify-content:center;position:relative;overflow:hidden}
.car .img .badge{z-index:1}
.car .img svg{width:82%}
.badge{position:absolute;top:12px;left:12px;background:var(--gold);color:#fff;font-size:11px;font-weight:800;padding:4px 9px;border-radius:6px;text-transform:uppercase}
.car .body{padding:16px 18px 18px;display:flex;flex-direction:column;flex:1}
.car .mk{font-size:12px;color:var(--gold2);font-weight:700;text-transform:uppercase;letter-spacing:1px}
.car h3{font-size:24px;line-height:1.1;margin:2px 0}
.car .ver{color:var(--mut);font-size:13px;min-height:20px}
.specs{display:flex;gap:14px;margin:14px 0;font-size:13px;color:#c4cad1;flex-wrap:wrap}
.specs span{display:flex;align-items:center;gap:5px}
.price{font-family:"Barlow Condensed";font-size:30px;font-weight:800;margin-top:auto}
.car .acts{display:flex;gap:8px;margin-top:12px}
.car .acts .btn{flex:1;justify-content:center;padding:10px 6px;font-size:13px;white-space:nowrap}

/* promo blocks */
.promo{display:grid;grid-template-columns:1fr 1fr;gap:20px}
.pbox{border-radius:20px;padding:38px;position:relative;overflow:hidden;min-height:250px;display:flex;flex-direction:column;justify-content:center}
.pbox h3{font-size:38px;text-transform:uppercase;line-height:1;margin-bottom:10px}
.pbox p{max-width:340px;margin-bottom:22px}
.pbox.a{background:linear-gradient(135deg,#fe7201,#d55d00);color:#fff}
.pbox.a .btn{background:#111;color:#fff}
.pbox.b{background:var(--card);border:1px solid var(--line)}
.pbox.b p{color:var(--mut)}
.pbox .ico{position:absolute;right:-10px;bottom:-14px;font-size:150px;opacity:.15}
@media(max-width:860px){.promo{grid-template-columns:1fr}}

/* why */
.why{display:grid;grid-template-columns:repeat(4,1fr);gap:20px}
.why>div{background:var(--bg2);border:1px solid var(--line);border-radius:14px;padding:24px}
.why .n{font-size:30px;margin-bottom:8px}
.why h4{font-size:17px;margin-bottom:4px}
.why p{color:var(--mut);font-size:14px}
@media(max-width:860px){.why{grid-template-columns:1fr 1fr}}

/* stock page */
.stock{display:grid;grid-template-columns:260px 1fr;gap:26px;align-items:start}
.filters{background:var(--card);border:1px solid var(--line);border-radius:16px;padding:20px;position:sticky;top:76px;display:grid;gap:14px}
.filters h4{font-family:"Barlow Condensed";font-size:22px;text-transform:uppercase}
.filters label{font-size:12px;color:var(--mut);font-weight:600;text-transform:uppercase}
.chips{display:flex;gap:6px;flex-wrap:wrap}
.chip{padding:7px 12px;border-radius:30px;border:1px solid var(--line);background:var(--bg2);color:#cfd4da;font-size:13px;font-weight:600}
.chip.on{background:var(--gold);color:#fff;border-color:var(--gold)}
.toolbar{display:flex;justify-content:space-between;align-items:center;margin-bottom:18px;gap:12px;flex-wrap:wrap}
.toolbar select{width:auto}
.empty{color:var(--mut);padding:40px;text-align:center;border:1px dashed var(--line);border-radius:14px}
@media(max-width:860px){.stock{grid-template-columns:1fr}.filters{position:static}}

/* page header */
.phead{padding:50px 0 30px;background:linear-gradient(180deg,#2a1404,var(--bg))}
.phead h1{font-size:52px;text-transform:uppercase;font-weight:800}
.phead h1 span{color:var(--gold)}
.phead p{color:var(--mut);max-width:620px}

/* forms */
.formbox{background:var(--card);border:1px solid var(--line);border-radius:18px;padding:28px}
.fgrid{display:grid;grid-template-columns:1fr 1fr;gap:14px}
.fgrid .full{grid-column:1/-1}
.fgrid label{font-size:13px;color:var(--mut);font-weight:600;display:block;margin-bottom:5px}
.two{display:grid;grid-template-columns:1.2fr 1fr;gap:26px;align-items:start}
.fin-grid{display:grid;grid-template-columns:1.2fr 1fr;gap:20px 26px;align-items:stretch}
.fin-grid .sim-box{display:grid;gap:20px;align-content:center}
.fin-grid .sim-out{display:flex;flex-direction:column;justify-content:center}
.fin-grid .cred-box{grid-column:1/-1;padding:22px 28px}
.cred-grid{display:grid;grid-template-columns:repeat(4,1fr);gap:12px 16px}
.cred-grid label{font-size:13px;color:var(--mut);font-weight:600;display:block;margin-bottom:5px}
.cred-grid .c2{grid-column:span 2}.cred-grid .c-full{grid-column:1/-1}
.cred-box .cred-foot{display:flex;align-items:center;gap:16px;flex-wrap:wrap;margin-top:14px}
@media(max-width:860px){.cred-grid{grid-template-columns:1fr 1fr}}
@media(max-width:520px){.cred-grid{grid-template-columns:1fr}.cred-grid .c2{grid-column:auto}}
@media(max-width:860px){.fin-grid{grid-template-columns:1fr}.fin-grid .cred-box{grid-column:1;padding:22px}}
@media(max-width:860px){.two,.fgrid{grid-template-columns:1fr}}
.radios{display:flex;gap:10px}
.rd{display:flex!important;align-items:center;gap:8px;background:var(--bg2);border:1px solid var(--line);padding:11px 18px;border-radius:9px;cursor:pointer;color:var(--txt)!important;font-size:15px!important;margin:0!important}
.rd input{width:18px;height:18px;accent-color:var(--gold)}
.rd:has(input:checked){border-color:var(--gold);background:#fe720118}
.consent{display:flex!important;gap:10px;align-items:flex-start;font-size:13px!important;color:var(--mut)!important;cursor:pointer;font-weight:500!important}
.consent input{width:18px;height:18px;flex:0 0 18px;accent-color:var(--gold);margin-top:1px}
input[type=date]{color-scheme:dark}
.ok{display:none;margin-top:16px;padding:14px;border-radius:10px;background:#1f3a24;color:#b9f0c6;font-size:14px}
.steps{display:grid;gap:14px}
.steps div{display:flex;gap:14px;background:var(--bg2);border:1px solid var(--line);padding:18px;border-radius:14px}
.steps b{flex:0 0 38px;height:38px;border-radius:50%;background:var(--gold);color:#fff;display:flex;align-items:center;justify-content:center;font-family:"Barlow Condensed";font-size:20px}
.steps p{color:var(--mut);font-size:14px}

/* simulator */
.sim-out{background:linear-gradient(135deg,#2a1505,#140c06);border:1px solid #fe720155;border-radius:18px;padding:28px;text-align:center}
.sim-out .v{font-family:"Barlow Condensed";font-size:56px;font-weight:800;color:var(--gold2);line-height:1}
.sim-out small{color:var(--mut)}
input[type=range]{padding:0;accent-color:var(--gold);background:none;border:0}
.rng{display:flex;justify-content:space-between;font-size:13px;color:var(--mut)}
.banks-t{color:var(--mut);font-size:12px;text-transform:uppercase;letter-spacing:1px;margin-top:20px}
.banks{display:grid;grid-template-columns:repeat(6,1fr);gap:6px;margin:10px auto 0;max-width:530px}
.banks .bank{display:flex;flex-direction:column;align-items:center;gap:3px;background:#ffffff08;border:1px solid var(--line);border-radius:8px;padding:6px 3px;font-size:9.8px;font-weight:600;color:#e3e6ea;text-align:center;line-height:1.2;min-width:0}
.banks .bl{width:100%;height:22px;border-radius:5px;display:flex;align-items:center;justify-content:center;font-size:10px;font-weight:800;color:#fff;overflow:hidden;background:#fff;padding:2px}
.banks .bl img{max-height:100%;max-width:100%;object-fit:contain;display:block}
@media(max-width:620px){.banks{grid-template-columns:repeat(4,1fr);gap:4px;max-width:300px}.banks .bank{padding:4px 2px;font-size:8.5px}.banks .bl{height:20px}}

/* detail modal */
.modal{position:fixed;inset:0;background:#000c;z-index:100;display:none;align-items:center;justify-content:center;padding:20px}
.modal.on{display:flex}
.mbox{background:var(--bg2);border:1px solid var(--line);border-radius:20px;max-width:900px;width:100%;max-height:92vh;overflow:auto;display:grid;grid-template-columns:1.1fr 1fr}
.mbox .img{display:flex;align-items:center;justify-content:center;min-height:300px}
.mbox .img svg{width:85%}
.mbox .info{padding:28px;position:relative}
.mbox .x{position:absolute;top:14px;right:16px;background:none;color:var(--mut);font-size:26px}
.tbl{width:100%;border-collapse:collapse;margin:16px 0;font-size:14px}
.tbl td{padding:8px 0;border-bottom:1px solid var(--line)}
.tbl td:first-child{color:var(--mut)}
.tbl td:last-child{text-align:right;font-weight:600}
.thumbs{display:flex;gap:6px;padding:8px;overflow-x:auto;background:#0d0f12}
.thumbs img{width:72px;height:52px;object-fit:cover;border-radius:6px;cursor:pointer;opacity:.6;border:2px solid transparent}
.thumbs img.on{opacity:1;border-color:var(--gold)}
@media(max-width:760px){.mbox{grid-template-columns:1fr}}

/* carrossel de novidades */
.carr{position:relative}
.ctrack{display:grid;grid-auto-flow:column;grid-auto-columns:calc((100% - 60px)/4);gap:20px;overflow-x:auto;scroll-snap-type:x mandatory;scroll-behavior:smooth;scrollbar-width:none;padding:4px 2px 8px}
.ctrack::-webkit-scrollbar{display:none}
.ctrack>.car{scroll-snap-align:start}
.cnav{position:absolute;top:38%;transform:translateY(-50%);z-index:3;width:52px;height:52px;border-radius:50%;background:var(--orange);color:#fff;font-size:34px;line-height:1;display:flex;align-items:center;justify-content:center;box-shadow:0 8px 22px #000a;transition:.15s}
.cnav:hover{background:var(--gold2);transform:translateY(-50%) scale(1.06)}
.cnav.l{left:-26px}.cnav.r{right:-26px}
.cnav[hidden]{display:none}
@media(max-width:1100px){.ctrack{grid-auto-columns:calc((100% - 40px)/3)}}
@media(max-width:860px){.ctrack{grid-auto-columns:calc((100% - 20px)/2)}.cnav.l{left:-6px}.cnav.r{right:-6px}.cnav{width:44px;height:44px;font-size:28px}}
@media(max-width:560px){.ctrack{grid-auto-columns:84%}}

/* página do veículo */
.vd-top{display:flex;align-items:center;justify-content:space-between;gap:12px;padding:18px 0 14px;flex-wrap:wrap}
.vd-back{color:#cfd4da;font-weight:600;display:inline-flex;gap:6px;align-items:center}
.vd-back:hover{color:var(--gold2)}
.vd-grid{display:grid;grid-template-columns:minmax(0,1.65fr) minmax(320px,1fr);gap:28px;align-items:start;padding-bottom:40px}
.gal{background:#090a0c;border:1px solid var(--line);border-radius:18px;overflow:hidden}
.gal-main{position:relative;aspect-ratio:4/3;background:#000;overflow:hidden;cursor:zoom-in;user-select:none}
.gal-main .bgblur{position:absolute;inset:-20px;background-size:cover;background-position:center;filter:blur(24px) brightness(.45)}
.gal-main img.main{position:absolute;inset:0;width:100%;height:100%;object-fit:contain}
.gal-main svg{position:absolute;inset:0;margin:auto;width:80%;height:80%}
.gal-nav{position:absolute;top:50%;transform:translateY(-50%);width:48px;height:48px;border-radius:50%;background:#000a;color:#fff;font-size:30px;line-height:1;display:flex;align-items:center;justify-content:center;z-index:2;transition:.15s}
.gal-nav:hover{background:var(--orange)}
.gal-nav.l{left:14px}.gal-nav.r{right:14px}
.gal-count{position:absolute;right:14px;bottom:14px;background:#000b;color:#fff;font-size:13px;font-weight:600;padding:5px 10px;border-radius:20px;z-index:2}
.gal-zoom{position:absolute;left:14px;bottom:14px;background:#000b;color:#fff;font-size:13px;font-weight:600;padding:5px 10px;border-radius:20px;z-index:2}
.gal-thumbs{display:flex;gap:8px;padding:10px;overflow-x:auto;scrollbar-width:thin}
.gal-thumbs img{flex:0 0 auto;width:96px;height:70px;object-fit:cover;border-radius:8px;cursor:pointer;opacity:.55;border:2px solid transparent;transition:.15s}
.gal-thumbs img:hover{opacity:.9}
.gal-thumbs img.on{opacity:1;border-color:var(--gold)}
.vd-grid>div:first-child{grid-column:1;grid-row:1}
.vd-grid>.vd-info{grid-column:2;grid-row:1/span 2}
.vd-grid>.vd-desc{grid-column:1;grid-row:2;margin-top:0}
.vd-info{position:sticky;top:76px;background:var(--card);border:1px solid var(--line);border-radius:18px;padding:26px}
.vd-info .mk{color:var(--gold2);font-weight:700;font-size:13px;text-transform:uppercase;letter-spacing:1px}
.vd-info h1{font-size:44px;line-height:1;text-transform:none;margin:4px 0}
.vd-info .ver{color:var(--mut);font-size:16px}
.vd-info .price{font-size:48px;margin:16px 0 4px}
.vd-sim{color:var(--mut);font-size:14px;margin-bottom:16px}
.vd-sim b{color:var(--gold2)}
.chipspec{display:grid;grid-template-columns:repeat(3,1fr);gap:8px;margin:16px 0}
.chipspec div{background:var(--bg2);border:1px solid var(--line);border-radius:12px;padding:10px;text-align:center}
.chipspec small{display:block;color:var(--mut);font-size:11px;text-transform:uppercase;letter-spacing:.5px}
.chipspec b{font-size:15px}
.vd-acts{display:grid;gap:10px}
.vd-acts .btn{justify-content:center;padding:15px;font-size:16px}
.vd-desc{background:var(--card);border:1px solid var(--line);border-radius:18px;padding:24px;margin-top:22px}
.vd-desc h3{font-size:26px;text-transform:uppercase;margin-bottom:10px}
.vd-desc p{color:#c9cfd6;white-space:pre-line}
.vd-bar{display:none}
@media(max-width:900px){
  .vd-grid{grid-template-columns:1fr}
  .vd-grid>div:first-child,.vd-grid>.vd-info,.vd-grid>.vd-desc{grid-column:1;grid-row:auto}
  .vd-info{position:static}
  .vd-info h1{font-size:36px}
  .gal{border-radius:0;margin:0 -20px;border-left:0;border-right:0}
  .gal-nav{width:40px;height:40px;font-size:24px}
  .gal-thumbs img{width:76px;height:56px}
  .vd-bar{display:flex;position:fixed;left:0;right:0;bottom:0;z-index:80;background:#0d0f12f2;border-top:1px solid var(--line);padding:10px 14px;gap:10px;align-items:center;backdrop-filter:blur(8px)}
  .vd-bar .p{font-family:"Barlow Condensed";font-size:26px;font-weight:800;flex:1}
  .vd-bar .btn{padding:12px 16px}
  body.on-vd .wa-float{display:none}
  body.on-vd{padding-bottom:70px}
}
/* lightbox */
.lb{position:fixed;inset:0;z-index:200;background:#000f;display:none;align-items:center;justify-content:center}
.lb.on{display:flex}
#lbImgWrap{width:100%;height:100%;display:flex;align-items:center;justify-content:center;padding:50px 70px}
#lbImg{max-width:100%;max-height:100%;object-fit:contain;user-select:none}
.lb-x{position:absolute;top:14px;right:18px;background:none;color:#fff;font-size:42px;z-index:2}
.lb-nav{position:absolute;top:50%;transform:translateY(-50%);width:56px;height:56px;border-radius:50%;background:#ffffff1a;color:#fff;font-size:36px;z-index:2}
.lb-nav:hover{background:var(--orange)}
.lb-nav.l{left:16px}.lb-nav.r{right:16px}
.lb-count{position:absolute;bottom:18px;left:50%;transform:translateX(-50%);color:#fff;font-size:14px;font-weight:600}
@media(max-width:700px){#lbImgWrap{padding:50px 0}.lb-nav{width:44px;height:44px;font-size:28px;background:#0008}}

/* contact & footer */
.contact{display:grid;grid-template-columns:repeat(3,1fr);gap:20px}
.contact div{background:var(--card);border:1px solid var(--line);border-radius:14px;padding:22px}
.contact h4{color:var(--gold2);font-size:13px;text-transform:uppercase;letter-spacing:1px;margin-bottom:6px}
@media(max-width:860px){.contact{grid-template-columns:1fr}}
footer{background:#000;border-top:1px solid var(--line);padding:40px 0 26px;color:var(--mut);font-size:14px}
footer .cols{display:grid;grid-template-columns:1.6fr 1fr 1fr 1.8fr;gap:24px;margin-bottom:28px}
.fcontact{text-align:right}
.fcontact p{margin-bottom:8px;color:#c9cfd6}
.si{vertical-align:middle;flex:0 0 auto}
.soc{display:inline-flex;align-items:center;gap:8px}
.fcontact .social a{display:inline-flex;align-items:center;gap:6px;margin-left:12px;color:var(--gold2);font-weight:600}
.fcontact h5{color:var(--gold2)!important;text-transform:uppercase;letter-spacing:1px}
footer h5{color:var(--txt);font-size:14px;margin-bottom:10px}
footer a{display:block;margin-bottom:6px}
footer a:hover{color:var(--gold2)}
footer .bot{border-top:1px solid var(--line);padding-top:18px;display:flex;justify-content:space-between;flex-wrap:wrap;gap:10px}
@media(max-width:860px){footer .cols{grid-template-columns:1fr 1fr}.fcontact{grid-column:1/-1;text-align:left}}

/* whatsapp float */
.wa-float{position:fixed;right:22px;bottom:22px;z-index:90;width:60px;height:60px;border-radius:50%;background:var(--wa);display:flex;align-items:center;justify-content:center;box-shadow:0 8px 24px #0008}
.wa-pop{position:fixed;right:22px;bottom:94px;z-index:90;width:310px;background:#fff;color:#111;border-radius:16px;overflow:hidden;display:none;box-shadow:0 14px 40px #000a}
.wa-pop.on{display:block}
.wa-pop .h{background:#075e54;color:#fff;padding:16px}
.wa-pop .h b{display:block}
.wa-pop .h small{opacity:.8}
.wa-pop form{padding:16px;display:grid;gap:10px}
.wa-pop input{background:#f3f4f6;border:1px solid #ddd;color:#111}
.wa-pop .note{font-size:12px;color:#555}
</style>
</head>

 {id:15,tipo:"Carro",marca:"Mitsubishi",modelo:"L200 Triton",versao:"Sport HPE-S 2.4 4x4",ano:"2021/2022",km:72500,preco:199900,cambio:"Automático",comb:"Diesel",cor:"Prata",forma:"pickup",hex:"#9ca1a7"},
 {id:16,tipo:"Carro",marca:"Chevrolet",modelo:"Tracker",versao:"Premier 1.2 Turbo Aut.",ano:"2023/2024",km:19700,preco:139900,cambio:"Automático",comb:"Flex",cor:"Vermelho",forma:"suv",hex:"#9e1f26"}

/* ========= ilustrações dos veículos ========= */
function carSVG(f,c){
  const shade="#0006",glass="#9fc3dd",wheel=`<circle r="15" fill="#15171a"/><circle r="8" fill="#8b9097"/><circle r="3" fill="#15171a"/>`;
  const W=(x)=>`<g transform="translate(${x},104)">${wheel}</g>`;
  const P={
   sedan:`<path d="M12 98c0-14 6-20 22-22l34-6 26-20c6-4 12-6 22-6h52c12 0 20 4 28 12l18 16 32 4c14 2 22 8 22 20v6H12z" fill="${c}"/><path d="M98 52l-22 20h56V48h-22c-6 0-9 1-12 4zM140 48v24h56l-16-16c-6-6-11-8-20-8z" fill="${glass}" opacity=".85"/><rect x="12" y="96" width="256" height="6" fill="${shade}"/>${W(66)}${W(212)}`,
   hatch:`<path d="M16 98c0-14 8-20 22-22l30-6 30-22c6-4 12-6 22-6h52c12 0 18 6 24 16l12 22c18 2 34 6 34 20v4H16z" fill="${c}"/><path d="M104 50l-24 20h56V46h-20c-6 0-9 1-12 4zM144 46v24h52l-10-18c-3-5-7-6-14-6z" fill="${glass}" opacity=".85"/><rect x="16" y="96" width="248" height="6" fill="${shade}"/>${W(70)}${W(206)}`,
   suv:`<path d="M12 100V78c0-8 6-12 16-14l38-6 22-24c5-5 11-6 20-6h82c12 0 18 4 24 12l16 20 22 4c10 2 16 8 16 18v18z" fill="${c}"/><path d="M92 36l-18 22h60V32h-30c-6 0-9 1-12 4zM142 32v26h62l-14-18c-4-6-8-8-16-8z" fill="${glass}" opacity=".85"/><rect x="12" y="98" width="258" height="6" fill="${shade}"/><rect x="100" y="24" width="90" height="4" rx="2" fill="#222"/>${W(68)}${W(214)}`,
   pickup:`<path d="M10 100V78c0-8 6-12 16-14l34-4 22-26c4-5 10-6 18-6h48c8 0 12 4 14 10v34h104v28z" fill="${c}"/><path d="M86 38l-18 22h56V34h-26c-6 0-9 1-12 4zM132 34v26h22V40c0-4-2-6-6-6z" fill="${glass}" opacity=".85"/><rect x="164" y="64" width="102" height="4" fill="${shade}"/><rect x="10" y="98" width="256" height="6" fill="${shade}"/>${W(66)}${W(214)}`,
   moto:`<g fill="none" stroke-linecap="round"><circle cx="70" cy="96" r="26" stroke="#15171a" stroke-width="9"/><circle cx="210" cy="96" r="26" stroke="#15171a" stroke-width="9"/><path d="M70 96l40-40h50l50 40M150 56l-14-20h-18" stroke="#8b9097" stroke-width="6"/></g><path d="M112 54c10-14 30-18 50-14l26 8-10 18h-62z" fill="${c}"/><path d="M168 42c14-2 30 2 40 10l-8 6c-8-6-20-8-30-6z" fill="#222"/><path d="M138 36l-10-14h-16" stroke="#222" stroke-width="5" fill="none"/>`
  };
  return `<svg viewBox="0 0 280 130"><ellipse cx="140" cy="122" rx="128" ry="6" fill="#000" opacity=".45"/>${P[f]}</svg>`;
}
const bg=(c)=>`background:radial-gradient(circle at 50% 60%, ${c}33, #121418 70%)`;

const fmt=n=>n.toLocaleString("pt-BR",{style:"currency",currency:"BRL",maximumFractionDigits:0});
const kmf=n=>n===0?"0 km":n.toLocaleString("pt-BR")+" km";
let marcas=[];

function card(v){
  return `<article class="car">
    <div class="img" style="${bg(v.hex)}">${v.novo?'<span class="badge">Novidade</span>':''}${v.km===0?'<span class="badge" style="left:auto;right:12px;background:#fff;color:#111">0 km</span>':''}${v.foto?`<img src="${v.foto}" alt="${v.marca} ${v.modelo}" style="width:100%;height:100%;object-fit:cover;position:absolute;inset:0">`:carSVG(v.forma,v.hex)}</div>
    <div class="body">
      <span class="mk">${v.marca}</span><h3>${v.modelo}</h3><div class="ver">${v.versao}</div>
      <div class="specs"><span>📅 ${v.ano}</span><span>🛣️ ${kmf(v.km)}</span><span>⚙️ ${v.cambio}</span></div>
      <div class="price">${fmt(v.preco)}</div>
      <div class="acts"><button class="btn btn-gold" onclick="openM(${v.id})">Ver mais</button><button class="btn btn-line" onclick="waVeh(${v.id})">Interesse</button></div>
    </div></article>`;
}

/* ========= filtros ========= */
const st={tipo:"",cambio:""};
function chips(id,opts,key){
  const el=document.getElementById(id);
  el.innerHTML=["Todos",...opts].map(o=>`<button class="chip ${(st[key]||"Todos")===o?"on":""}" data-o="${o}">${o}</button>`).join("");
  el.onclick=e=>{const o=e.target.dataset.o;if(!o)return;st[key]=o==="Todos"?"":o;chips(id,opts,key);render();};
}
function render(){
  const txt=fTxt.value.trim().toLowerCase(),m=fMarca.value,p=+fPreco.value,a=+fAno.value||0;
  fPrecoL.textContent=p>=400000?"sem limite":fmt(p);
  let r=ESTOQUE.filter(v=>(!st.tipo||v.tipo===st.tipo)&&(!st.cambio||v.cambio===st.cambio)&&(!m||v.marca===m)&&(p>=400000||v.preco<=p)&&(parseInt(v.ano.split("/")[1])>=a)&&(!txt||(v.marca+" "+v.modelo+" "+v.versao).toLowerCase().includes(txt)));
  const s=sort.value;
  if(s==="pa")r.sort((x,y)=>x.preco-y.preco);
  if(s==="pd")r.sort((x,y)=>y.preco-x.preco);
  if(s==="km")r.sort((x,y)=>x.km-y.km);
  if(s==="ano")r.sort((x,y)=>y.ano.localeCompare(x.ano));
  if(s==="rec")r.sort((x,y)=>((y.novo?1:0)-(x.novo?1:0))||(x.idx-y.idx));
  count.textContent=r.length+(r.length===1?" veículo encontrado":" veículos encontrados");
  lista.innerHTML=r.length?r.map(card).join(""):`<div class="empty" style="grid-column:1/-1">Nenhum veículo com esses filtros. <a class="link-more" href="#" onclick="resetFilters();return false">Limpar filtros</a></div>`;
}
function resetFilters(){st.tipo="";st.cambio="";fTxt.value="";fMarca.value="";fPreco.value=400000;fAno.value="";sort.value="rec";chips("fTipo",["Carro","Moto"],"tipo");chips("fCambio",["Automático","Manual"],"cambio");render();}
function goStock(opts){resetFilters();if(opts.marca)fMarca.value=opts.marca;if(opts.tipo){st.tipo=opts.tipo;chips("fTipo",["Carro","Moto"],"tipo");}if(opts.preco)fPreco.value=opts.preco;if(opts.ano)fAno.value=opts.ano;render();location.hash="estoque";}
function quickSearch(e){e.preventDefault();goStock({tipo:qTipo.value,marca:qMarca.value,preco:qPreco.value,ano:qAno.value});}

/* ========= página do veículo ========= */
let VD=null, vdIdx=0, vdPending=null, estoqueOk=false;
function openM(id){location.hash="veiculo-"+id;}
function closeM(){if(window._vdFromSite){window._vdFromSite=false;history.back();}else{location.hash="estoque";}}
function simVeh(p){sVal.value=p;sim();location.hash="financie";}
function vFotos(v){return v.fotos&&v.fotos.length?v.fotos:(v.foto?[v.foto]:[]);}
function parcela(v){const F=v.preco*0.7,i=0.0179,n=48;return F*i/(1-Math.pow(1+i,-n));}
function renderVD(id){
  const v=ESTOQUE.find(x=>String(x.id)===String(id));
  if(!v){vd.innerHTML=`<div class="wrap" style="padding:60px 20px"><div class="empty">Este veículo não está mais disponível. <a class="link-more" href="#estoque">Ver estoque →</a></div></div>`;return;}
  VD=v;vdIdx=0;const F=vFotos(v);TRK("ver_veiculo",v.id);
  const sim=v.preco?`ou <b>48x de ${parcela(v).toLocaleString("pt-BR",{style:"currency",currency:"BRL"})}</b> com 30% de entrada*`:"";
  const sem=ESTOQUE.filter(x=>x.id!==v.id&&x.tipo===v.tipo).sort((a,b)=>Math.abs(a.preco-v.preco)-Math.abs(b.preco-v.preco)).slice(0,4);
  vd.innerHTML=`<div class="wrap">
    <div class="vd-top"><a href="#" class="vd-back" onclick="closeM();return false">← Voltar</a>
      <button class="btn btn-line" style="padding:8px 14px;font-size:13px" onclick="shareV()">🔗 Compartilhar</button></div>
    <div class="vd-grid">
      <div>
        <div class="gal">
          <div class="gal-main" id="galMain">
            ${F.length?`<div class="bgblur" id="galBg"></div><img class="main" id="galImg" alt="${v.marca} ${v.modelo}">`:carSVG(v.forma,v.hex)}
            ${F.length>1?`<button class="gal-nav l" onclick="event.stopPropagation();galGo(-1)" aria-label="Foto anterior">‹</button><button class="gal-nav r" onclick="event.stopPropagation();galGo(1)" aria-label="Próxima foto">›</button>`:""}
            ${F.length?`<span class="gal-zoom">⤢ Ampliar</span><span class="gal-count" id="galCount"></span>`:""}
          </div>
          ${F.length>1?`<div class="gal-thumbs" id="galThumbs">${F.map((f,i)=>`<img src="${f}" data-i="${i}" loading="lazy" alt="Foto ${i+1}">`).join("")}</div>`:""}
        </div>
      </div>
      <aside class="vd-info">
        <div class="mk">${v.marca}</div>
        <h1>${v.modelo}</h1>
        <div class="ver">${v.versao||""}</div>
        <div class="price">${fmt(v.preco)}</div>
        <div class="vd-sim">${sim}</div>
        <div class="chipspec">
          <div><small>Ano</small><b>${v.ano||"-"}</b></div>
          <div><small>KM</small><b>${kmf(v.km)}</b></div>
          <div><small>Câmbio</small><b>${v.cambio||"-"}</b></div>
          <div><small>Combustível</small><b>${v.comb||"-"}</b></div>
          <div><small>Cor</small><b>${v.cor||"-"}</b></div>
          <div><small>Tipo</small><b>${v.tipo}</b></div>
        </div>
        <div class="vd-acts">
          <button class="btn btn-wa" onclick="waVeh(${JSON.stringify(v.id)})">💬 Tenho interesse — WhatsApp</button>
          <button class="btn btn-line" onclick="simVeh(${v.preco})">Simular financiamento</button>
          <a class="btn btn-line" href="#venda">Tenho um carro para dar na troca</a>
        </div>
        <p style="color:var(--mut);font-size:12px;margin-top:14px">*Simulação aproximada, taxa 1,79% a.m. Sujeita a análise de crédito.</p>
      </aside>
      ${v.descricao?`<div class="vd-desc"><h3>Sobre este veículo</h3><p>${v.descricao}</p></div>`:""}
    </div>
    ${sem.length?`<section style="padding:10px 0 60px"><div class="sec-head"><h2>Veículos <span>semelhantes</span></h2><a href="#estoque" class="link-more">Ver todo estoque →</a></div><div class="grid">${sem.map(card).join("")}</div></section>`:""}
  </div>
  <div class="vd-bar"><span class="p">${fmt(v.preco)}</span><button class="btn btn-wa" onclick="waVeh(${JSON.stringify(v.id)})">💬 WhatsApp</button></div>`;
  if(F.length){
    galShow(0);
    galMain.onclick=()=>lbOpen(vdIdx);
    const th=document.getElementById("galThumbs");if(th)th.onclick=e=>{const i=e.target.dataset.i;if(i!=null)galShow(+i);};
    swipe(galMain,d=>galGo(d));
  }
  document.title=`${v.marca} ${v.modelo} ${v.ano||""} — Prime Motors`;
}
function galShow(i){
  const F=vFotos(VD);if(!F.length)return;vdIdx=(i+F.length)%F.length;
  galImg.src=F[vdIdx];galBg.style.backgroundImage=`url('${F[vdIdx]}')`;
  galCount.textContent=`${vdIdx+1} / ${F.length}`;
  const th=document.getElementById("galThumbs");
  if(th){th.querySelectorAll("img").forEach((t,j)=>t.classList.toggle("on",j===vdIdx));const a=th.children[vdIdx];a&&a.scrollIntoView({block:"nearest",inline:"center",behavior:"smooth"});}
  [vdIdx+1,vdIdx-1].forEach(j=>{const u=F[(j+F.length)%F.length];if(u){const im=new Image();im.src=u;}});
}
function galGo(d){galShow(vdIdx+d);}
function lbOpen(i){const F=vFotos(VD);if(!F.length)return;lb.classList.add("on");document.body.style.overflow="hidden";lbShow(i);}
function lbShow(i){const F=vFotos(VD);vdIdx=(i+F.length)%F.length;lbImg.src=F[vdIdx];lbCount.textContent=`${vdIdx+1} / ${F.length}`;}
function lbGo(d){lbShow(vdIdx+d);}
function lbClose(){lb.classList.remove("on");document.body.style.overflow="";if(VD)galShow(vdIdx);}
document.addEventListener("keydown",e=>{
  if(lb.classList.contains("on")){if(e.key==="Escape")lbClose();if(e.key==="ArrowLeft")lbGo(-1);if(e.key==="ArrowRight")lbGo(1);return;}
  if(document.getElementById("v-veiculo").classList.contains("on")&&VD){if(e.key==="ArrowLeft")galGo(-1);if(e.key==="ArrowRight")galGo(1);if(e.key==="Escape")closeM();}
});
function swipe(el,cb){let x0=null;el.addEventListener("touchstart",e=>{x0=e.touches[0].clientX},{passive:true});el.addEventListener("touchend",e=>{if(x0==null)return;const dx=e.changedTouches[0].clientX-x0;if(Math.abs(dx)>40){cb(dx<0?1:-1);el._sw=Date.now();}x0=null;});
  el.addEventListener("click",e=>{if(el._sw&&Date.now()-el._sw<400)e.stopImmediatePropagation();},true);}
swipe(lb,d=>lbGo(d));
function shareV(){if(VD)TRK("compartilhar",VD.id);const u=location.href;const t=VD?`${VD.marca} ${VD.modelo} ${VD.ano} — ${fmt(VD.preco)}`:"Prime Motors";
  if(navigator.share){navigator.share({title:t,url:u}).catch(()=>{});}
  else if(navigator.clipboard){navigator.clipboard.writeText(u).then(()=>alertMini("Link copiado!"));}}
function alertMini(t){const d=document.createElement("div");d.textContent=t;d.style.cssText="position:fixed;left:50%;bottom:90px;transform:translateX(-50%);background:#173a22;color:#b9f0c6;padding:10px 16px;border-radius:10px;z-index:300;font-weight:600";document.body.appendChild(d);setTimeout(()=>d.remove(),2200);}

/* ========= bancos parceiros =========
   Para usar a logo oficial: salve a imagem (PNG ou JPG, quadrada) na pasta "logos"
   com o nome indicado em "arq" (ex.: logos/bv.png). Sem arquivo, aparece o selo com as iniciais. */
const BANCOS=[
  {nome:"Banco BV",sig:"BV",cor:"#1f4e9c",arq:"bv"},
  {nome:"C6 Bank",sig:"C6",cor:"#2b2b2b",arq:"c6"},
  {nome:"Banco Santander",sig:"S",cor:"#b3202a",arq:"santander"},
  {nome:"Carbank",sig:"CB",cor:"#0f7a6b",arq:"carbank"},
  {nome:"Banco Pan",sig:"PAN",cor:"#2a6fd6",arq:"pan"},
  {nome:"Banco Omni",sig:"OM",cor:"#6a3fa0",arq:"omni"},
  {nome:"Banco Itaú",sig:"IT",cor:"#d9661a",arq:"itau"},
  {nome:"Banco Safra",sig:"SF",cor:"#14365e",arq:"safra"},
  {nome:"Banco Bradesco",sig:"BR",cor:"#c4123b",arq:"bradesco"},
  {nome:"Banco Daycoval",sig:"DY",cor:"#0a5c8a",arq:"daycoval"},
  {nome:"Creditas",sig:"CR",cor:"#2e8b57",arq:"creditas"}
];
function renderBancos(){
  const el=document.getElementById("banks");if(!el)return;
  el.innerHTML=BANCOS.map(b=>`<span class="bank"><span class="bl" style="background:${b.cor}"><img src="logos/${b.arq}.png" alt="" onload="this.parentNode.style.background='#fff'" onerror="this.replaceWith(document.createTextNode('${b.sig}'))"></span>${b.nome}</span>`).join("");
}
renderBancos();
(function(){const el=document.getElementById("vAno");if(!el)return;const y=new Date().getFullYear();
  for(let f=y;f>=1985;f--){[f+1,f].forEach(m=>{if(m>y+1)return;el.add(new Option(`${f}/${m}`,`${f}/${m}`));});}})();

/* ========= simulador ========= */
let prazo=48;
function sim(){
  const V=+sVal.value,E=V*(+sEnt.value)/100,i=+sTax.value/100,F=V-E;
  const parc=F*i/(1-Math.pow(1+i,-prazo));
  sValL.textContent=fmt(V);sEntL.textContent=sEnt.value+"% ("+fmt(E)+")";sTaxL.textContent=(+sTax.value).toFixed(2).replace(".",",")+"% a.m.";
  sOut.textContent=prazo+"x "+parc.toLocaleString("pt-BR",{style:"currency",currency:"BRL"});
  sDet.textContent="Valor financiado: "+fmt(F)+" · Total: "+fmt(parc*prazo+E);
  sPrazo.innerHTML=[12,24,36,48,60].map(n=>`<button class="chip ${n===prazo?"on":""}" onclick="prazo=${n};sim()">${n}x</button>`).join("");
}

/* ========= WhatsApp / formulários ========= */
const waLink=msg=>"https://wa.me/"+LOJA.whatsapp+"?text="+encodeURIComponent(msg);
function openWa(e){e&&e.preventDefault();waPop.classList.toggle("on");}
/* ========= estatísticas anônimas ========= */
const TRK=(()=>{let vid="";try{vid=localStorage.getItem("pm_vid")||"";if(!vid){vid=Math.random().toString(36).slice(2)+Date.now().toString(36);localStorage.setItem("pm_vid",vid);}}catch(e){vid="s"+Math.random().toString(36).slice(2);}
  let staff=false;try{staff=localStorage.getItem("pm_staff")==="1";}catch(e){}
  const seen=new Set();
  return function(tipo,veiculo_id,detalhe){
    const C=window.PRIME_CONFIG||{};if(staff||!C.supabaseUrl||!/^https:\/\//.test(C.supabaseUrl))return;
    const k=tipo+":"+(veiculo_id||"")+":"+(detalhe||"");
    if((tipo==="visita"||tipo==="ver_veiculo")){try{if(sessionStorage.getItem("pm_e_"+k))return;sessionStorage.setItem("pm_e_"+k,"1");}catch(e){if(seen.has(k))return;seen.add(k);}}
    const id=veiculo_id!=null&&/^\d+$/.test(String(veiculo_id))?+veiculo_id:null;
    try{fetch(C.supabaseUrl.replace(/\/$/,"")+"/rest/v1/eventos",{method:"POST",keepalive:true,headers:{apikey:C.supabaseKey,"Content-Type":"application/json",Prefer:"return=minimal"},
      body:JSON.stringify({tipo,veiculo_id:id,visitante:vid.slice(0,40),detalhe:detalhe?String(detalhe).slice(0,40):null})}).catch(()=>{});}catch(e){}
  };})();
function openLink(u){const w=window.open(u,"_blank");if(w){try{w.opener=null}catch(e){}}else{location.href=u;}}
function waSend(e){e.preventDefault();TRK("whatsapp",VD&&document.getElementById("v-veiculo").classList.contains("on")?VD.id:null,"botao");
  const nome=waNome.value.trim(),tel=waTel.value.trim();
  const ctx=VD&&document.getElementById("v-veiculo").classList.contains("on")?` Tenho interesse no ${VD.marca} ${VD.modelo} ${VD.ano} (${fmt(VD.preco)}).`:" Gostaria de atendimento.";
  const u=waLink(`Olá! Sou ${nome}${tel?` (${tel})`:""}.${ctx}`);
  openLink(u);waPop.classList.remove("on");}
function waVeh(id){const v=ESTOQUE.find(x=>String(x.id)===String(id));if(!v)return;TRK("whatsapp",v.id,"interesse");
  openLink(waLink(`Olá! Tenho interesse no ${v.marca} ${v.modelo} ${v.versao||""} ${v.ano} (${fmt(v.preco)}).\n${location.origin+location.pathname}#veiculo-${v.id}`));}
function maskCpf(el){let d=el.value.replace(/\D/g,"").slice(0,11);el.value=d.replace(/(\d{3})(\d)/,"$1.$2").replace(/(\d{3})(\d)/,"$1.$2").replace(/(\d{3})(\d{1,2})$/,"$1-$2");el.setCustomValidity("");}
function maskTel(el){let d=el.value.replace(/\D/g,"").slice(0,11);el.value=d.length>10?d.replace(/(\d{2})(\d)(\d{4})(\d{4})/,"($1) $2 $3-$4"):d.replace(/(\d{2})(\d{0,4})(\d{0,4})/,(m,a,b,c)=>a?`(${a}) ${b}${c?"-"+c:""}`:"");}
function cpfOk(v){const c=v.replace(/\D/g,"");if(c.length!==11||/^(\d)\1+$/.test(c))return false;
  const dv=n=>{let s=0;for(let i=0;i<n;i++)s+=+c[i]*(n+1-i);const r=s*10%11;return r===10?0:r;};return dv(9)===+c[9]&&dv(10)===+c[10];}
function sendForm(e,id,tipo){e.preventDefault();
  const f=e.target,cpf=f.querySelector("#fCpf");
  if(cpf&&!cpfOk(cpf.value)){cpf.setCustomValidity("CPF inválido. Confira os números.");cpf.reportValidity();return;}
  const lbl=el=>{const box=el.closest(".full,div");const lb=box&&box.querySelector(":scope > label");return lb?lb.textContent.replace(/\s*\*\s*$/,"").trim():"Info";};
  const linhas=[];
  f.querySelectorAll("input,select,textarea").forEach(el=>{
    if(el.type==="range"||el.type==="checkbox"||!el.value)return;
    if(el.type==="radio"){if(el.checked){const g=el.closest(".grp,.full");const t=g&&g.querySelector(":scope > label");linhas.push(`${t?t.textContent.replace(/\s*\*\s*$/,"").trim():el.name}: ${el.value}`);}return;}
    let v=el.value.trim();if(el.type==="date"&&/^\d{4}-\d{2}-\d{2}$/.test(v))v=v.split("-").reverse().join("/");
    linhas.push(`${lbl(el)}: ${v}`);});
  const extra=tipo==="Financiamento"?`\nSimulação: ${sOut.textContent} (${sDet.textContent})`:"";
  TRK("formulario",null,tipo);
  openLink(waLink(`Olá! Vim pelo site da Prime Motors — ${tipo}.\n${linhas.join("\n")}${extra}`));
  const el=document.getElementById(id);el.style.display="block";
  el.innerHTML=`✓ Abrimos o WhatsApp da loja com seus dados. Se não abriu, <a href="${waLink("Olá! Vim pelo site — "+tipo)}" target="_blank" rel="noopener" style="color:#fff;font-weight:700;text-decoration:underline">clique aqui</a>.`;}

/* ========= rotas ========= */
const VIEWS=["inicio","estoque","venda","financie","sobre","contato","veiculo"];
let lastView=null;
function route(){
  let h=location.hash.slice(1),vid=null;
  if(/^veiculo-/.test(h)){vid=h.slice(8);h="veiculo";}
  if(!VIEWS.includes(h))h="inicio";
  if(h!=="veiculo"){document.title="Prime Motors — Veículos Selecionados | Alta Floresta/MT";if(lb.classList.contains("on"))lbClose();}
  if(h==="veiculo"&&lastView&&lastView!=="veiculo")window._vdFromSite=true;
  VIEWS.forEach(v=>document.getElementById("v-"+v).classList.toggle("on",v===h));
  document.body.classList.toggle("on-vd",h==="veiculo");
  document.querySelectorAll("nav a").forEach(a=>a.classList.toggle("on",a.dataset.v===h||(h==="veiculo"&&a.dataset.v==="estoque")));
  document.getElementById("nav").classList.remove("open");
  if(h==="veiculo"){if(estoqueOk)renderVD(vid);else{vdPending=vid;vd.innerHTML='<div class="wrap" style="padding:80px 20px;color:var(--mut)">Carregando veículo…</div>';}}
  lastView=h;
  window.scrollTo(0,0);
}
window.addEventListener("hashchange",route);

/* ========= carrossel "Últimas novidades" =========
   Carro cadastrado aparece como Novidade por NOVO_DIAS dias; depois fica só no estoque normal. */
const NOVO_DIAS=7;
function carrGo(d){const t=document.getElementById("novidades");const c=t.querySelector(".car");if(!c)return;
  const step=c.getBoundingClientRect().width+20,max=t.scrollWidth-t.clientWidth-2;
  if(d>0&&t.scrollLeft>=max)t.scrollTo({left:0,behavior:"smooth"});
  else if(d<0&&t.scrollLeft<=2)t.scrollTo({left:max+2,behavior:"smooth"});
  else t.scrollBy({left:d*step,behavior:"smooth"});}
function carrUpd(){const t=document.getElementById("novidades");const on=t.scrollWidth>t.clientWidth+4;
  document.querySelectorAll("#carrNov .cnav").forEach(b=>b.hidden=!on);}
window.addEventListener("resize",()=>{try{carrUpd()}catch(e){}});

/* ========= vitrine da página inicial ========= */
let hsT=null,hsI=0,hsList=[];
function heroShow(){
  if(!ESTOQUE.length)return;
  hsList=[...ESTOQUE].sort(()=>Math.random()-.5).slice(0,10);hsI=0;
  heroCar.innerHTML=`<div class="hshow" id="hshow">${hsList.map((v,i)=>{const f=vFotos(v)[0];
    return `<div class="hslide${i?"":" on"}" data-id="${v.id}">${f?`<div class="bgb" style="background-image:url('${f}')"></div><img src="${f}" alt="${v.marca} ${v.modelo}" ${i>1?'loading="lazy"':""}>`:carSVG(v.forma,v.hex)}
      <div class="hcap"><div><div class="mk">${v.marca}</div><h3>${v.modelo}</h3><div class="y">${v.ano||""} · ${kmf(v.km)}</div></div><span class="p">${fmt(v.preco)}</span></div></div>`;}).join("")}
    ${hsList.length>1?`<button class="hnav l" aria-label="Anterior">‹</button><button class="hnav r" aria-label="Próximo">›</button><div class="hdots">${hsList.map((_,i)=>`<i data-i="${i}" class="${i?"":"on"}"></i>`).join("")}</div>`:""}</div>`;
  const box=document.getElementById("hshow");
  box.onclick=e=>{
    if(e.target.closest(".hnav")){hsGo(hsI+(e.target.closest(".l")?-1:1));return;}
    const d=e.target.closest(".hdots i");if(d){hsGo(+d.dataset.i);return;}
    openM(hsList[hsI].id);};
  box.onmouseenter=()=>clearInterval(hsT);box.onmouseleave=hsPlay;
  swipe(box,d=>hsGo(hsI+d));hsPlay();
}
function hsGo(i){const sl=document.querySelectorAll("#hshow .hslide"),dt=document.querySelectorAll("#hshow .hdots i");if(!sl.length)return;
  hsI=(i+sl.length)%sl.length;sl.forEach((s,j)=>s.classList.toggle("on",j===hsI));dt.forEach((d,j)=>d.classList.toggle("on",j===hsI));}
function hsPlay(){clearInterval(hsT);if(hsList.length>1)hsT=setInterval(()=>{if(!document.hidden&&document.getElementById("v-inicio").classList.contains("on"))hsGo(hsI+1);},4500);}

/* ========= banco de dados (Supabase) ========= */
const CORES={branco:"#eeeeee",preto:"#222428",prata:"#aab0b6",cinza:"#666b72",vermelho:"#b3262b",azul:"#2f5aa8",verde:"#2f7a3a",amarelo:"#e0b020",laranja:"#fe7201",marrom:"#6b4a2b",bege:"#cbb89a",vinho:"#6d1a26",dourado:"#c9a24a"};
const esc=t=>String(t??"").replace(/[&<>"']/g,c=>({"&":"&amp;","<":"&lt;",">":"&gt;",'"':"&quot;","'":"&#39;"}[c]));
const FORMAS={"Hatch":"hatch","Sedã":"sedan","SUV":"suv","Picape":"pickup","Moto":"moto"};
async function loadEstoque(){
  const C=window.PRIME_CONFIG||{};
  if(!C.supabaseUrl||!/^https:\/\//.test(C.supabaseUrl)){ESTOQUE.forEach((v,i)=>v.idx=i);return;}
  try{
    const base=C.supabaseUrl.replace(/\/$/,"")+"/rest/v1/veiculos?",H={headers:{apikey:C.supabaseKey}};
    const COLS="id,created_at,tipo,carroceria,marca,modelo,versao,ano,km,preco,cambio,comb,cor,descricao,fotos,destaque,vendido,pausado,arquivado";
    let r=await fetch(base+`select=${COLS}&vendido=eq.false&pausado=eq.false&arquivado=eq.false&order=created_at.desc`,H);
    if(!r.ok)r=await fetch(base+"select=*&vendido=eq.false&order=created_at.desc",H);
    if(!r.ok)throw new Error(r.status);
    const rows=await r.json();
    ESTOQUE=rows.map((d,i)=>({id:d.id,idx:i,tipo:d.tipo==="Moto"?"Moto":"Carro",marca:esc(d.marca),modelo:esc(d.modelo),versao:esc(d.versao),ano:esc(d.ano),km:+d.km||0,preco:+d.preco||0,
      cambio:esc(d.cambio),comb:esc(d.comb),cor:esc(d.cor),descricao:esc(d.descricao),forma:d.tipo==="Moto"?"moto":(FORMAS[d.carroceria]||"sedan"),
      hex:CORES[(d.cor||"").toLowerCase()]||"#8a9099",fotos:(d.fotos||[]).filter(f=>/^https:\/\//.test(f)).map(esc),foto:(d.fotos||[]).filter(f=>/^https:\/\//.test(f)).map(esc)[0]||"",novo:!!d.created_at&&(Date.now()-Date.parse(d.created_at))<NOVO_DIAS*864e5,criado:d.created_at||""}));
  }catch(e){ESTOQUE=[];console.error("Erro ao carregar estoque",e);}
}

/* ========= init ========= */
document.querySelectorAll(".tel").forEach(e=>e.textContent=LOJA.telefone);
document.querySelectorAll(".addr").forEach(e=>e.textContent=LOJA.endereco);
heroCar.innerHTML=carSVG("suv","#fe7201").replace("<svg","<svg class='hero-car'");
sim();route();
TRK("visita");
loadEstoque().then(()=>{
  marcas=[...new Set(ESTOQUE.map(v=>v.marca))].sort();
  marcas.forEach(m=>{qMarca.add(new Option(m,m));fMarca.add(new Option(m,m));});
  if(window.brands)brands.innerHTML=marcas.map((m,i)=>`<a href="#" class="brand" data-i="${i}">${m}<small>${ESTOQUE.filter(v=>v.marca===m).length} no estoque</small></a>`).join("");
  if(window.brands)brands.onclick=e=>{const a=e.target.closest(".brand");if(!a)return;e.preventDefault();goStock({marca:marcas[+a.dataset.i]});};
  const nov=ESTOQUE.filter(v=>v.novo).sort((a,b)=>String(b.criado||"").localeCompare(String(a.criado||"")));
  const secNov=document.getElementById("carrNov").closest("section");
  secNov.style.display=nov.length?"":"none";
  novidades.innerHTML=nov.map(card).join("");
  carrUpd();
  resetFilters();
  estoqueOk=true;if(vdPending!=null){renderVD(vdPending);vdPending=null;}
  heroShow();
});
</script>
